thesis: A net-cash, high-ROIC Japanese noodle and food maker with rising rolling margins trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E and P/FCF and well below peers, pricing no growth.
reason: Fundamentals have improved since purchase: rolling operating and FCF margins rose and multiples sit at or below their own 5-year lows. The margin-reversion risk is real but the net-cash balance sheet cushions it. Held at its current size; cash above the floor is too small for a meaningful ADD.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 18%, giving up most of the rise from 11.4% in FY2022 to 24.4%.
TTM operating margin falls below 13%, back under the FY2024 level of 13.6%, showing the margin gains were input-cost relief.
TTM gross margin falls below 28%, under the FY2024 level of 28.7%, signalling lost pricing power.
TTM FCF margin falls below 6%, back to the level of a year earlier, showing the cash recovery was transitory.
